# SURFboard S34 replies

Raw `GetMultipleHNAPs` replies captured with `tools/capture.py` from a real
ARRIS/Vantiva SURFboard S34 (firmware `AT01.01.010.042324_S3.04.735`,
DOCSIS 3.1) on 2026-11-19, while the line was unstable (repeated loss of
sync, T3/T4 time-outs). One file per modem status page.

Identifiers are replaced with reserved documentation values: the modem MAC
with `00:00:5E:00:53:01`, the CMTS MAC with `00:00:5E:00:53:02`, the public IP
with `203.0.113.7`, and the serial number with zeros. Everything else is as
the modem sent it.
